decisions.decision: Rhonda Lisio elected Chairman, Steve Walker elected Vice-Chairman, and Jeffrey Bajko elected Secretary; all members accepted their nominations.
decisions.quote: rhonda lisio was elected chairman, steve walker was elected vice-chairman, and jeffrey bajko was elected secretary.

decisions.decision: The committee approved obtaining an official proposal from Robert Hague of Access/AV to update the control room in the town hall, to be submitted at the February meeting.
decisions.quote: the committee approved to get an official proposal from robert hague of access/av to update the control room in the town hall.

decisions.decision: The board created a master list of policies to be reviewed and approved: producer's agreement, public access equipment rental, political coverage, membership, programming, bulletin board, and purchasing.
decisions.quote: the board created a master list of policies to be reviewed and approved.

decisions.decision: A studio access policy is to be written and discussed at a later date.
decisions.quote: the pacc discussed a new policy that should be written: studio access policy. it will be discussed at a later date.

decisions.decision: The PACC will review, make corrections and approve four policies at the January meeting: bulletin board, purchase, membership, and equipment rental.
decisions.quote: the pacc will review, make corrections and approve four policies at the january meeting.

decisions.decision: New policies will be added when needed.
decisions.quote: the pacc also decided that new policies will be added when needed.

decisions.decision: The committee will review the FY 2015 budget before the next meeting and discuss changes and vote to approve it at that meeting.
decisions.quote: the committee will review the budget before next meeting.

decisions.decision: Members agreed to look at other cities' public access websites and their policies for ideas (recommended by Bob Ebersole).
decisions.quote: bob ebersole recommended going on other cities public access website and look at their policies to get ideas.

decisions.decision: The next meeting agenda is to include policies, FY 2015 budget, open houses, equipment training, and PAC marketing strategies.
decisions.quote: some of the items the committee will be discussing are policies, fy 2015 budget, open houses,
